headline: Kenya Signs $692 Million LNG Power Plant Deal with Greek Firm AMACO Energy
summary: Kenya signed a $692 million agreement with Greek energy company AMACO Energy SA to develop a liquefied natural gas power plant supplying an industrial park near Mombasa.
why: Large-scale energy infrastructure investments support industrial park development and power reliability for energy-intensive sectors like data centers.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Foreign investment in energy infrastructure boosts industrial capacity and power supply.
